import pandas as pd

# File paths for source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_1.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# --- Step 1: Prepare Source 1 (2017 data) ---
# Source0 schema corresponds to 2017 columns in target, except it lacks 'Region'
# Columns in df0: ['Country', 'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
#                 'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17']

# --- Step 2: Prepare Source 2 (2015 data) ---
# Source1 schema corresponds to 2015 columns in target, with slightly different column names:
# ['Country', 'Region', 'Happiness Rank', 'Happiness Score', 'Standard Error', 'Economy (GDP per Capita)',
#  'Family', 'Health (Life Expectancy)', 'Freedom', 'Trust (Government Corruption)', 'Generosity', 'Dystopia Residual']

# Rename Source1 columns to match target 2015 columns exactly
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
})

# --- Step 3: Join the two sources on 'Country' ---
# Target table has both 2015 and 2017 columns, so join on 'Country' to combine them
# df0 has no 'Region', df1 has 'Region' - keep 'Region' from df1

# Before join, ensure 'Country' columns are consistent in case (strip spaces if any)
df0['Country'] = df0['Country'].str.strip()
df1_renamed['Country'] = df1_renamed['Country'].str.strip()

# Perform inner join on 'Country' to keep only countries present in both sources
df_merged = pd.merge(df1_renamed, df0, on='Country', how='inner')

# --- Step 4: Select and reorder columns to match target schema exactly ---
target_columns = [
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
    'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

# Some columns might have missing values after join, ensure all columns exist
for col in target_columns:
    if col not in df_merged.columns:
        df_merged[col] = pd.NA

df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

# --- Step 5: Data type conversions to match target schema ---
# According to target schema:
# Country, Region: string (object)
# Happiness_Rank_15, Happiness_Rank_17: integer
# Happiness_Score_15, Standard_Error_15, Economy_15, Family_15, Life_Expectancy_15, Freedom_15, Trust_15, Generosity_15, Dystopia_15: float
# Happiness_Score_17, Whisker_High_17, Whisker_Low_17, Economy_17, Family_17, Life_Expectancy_17, Freedom_17, Generosity_17, Trust_17, Dystopia_17: float

# Convert string columns
df_final['Country'] = df_final['Country'].astype(str)
df_final['Region'] = df_final['Region'].astype(str)

# Convert integer columns (may have float values, so convert carefully)
int_cols = ['Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Rank_17']
for col in int_cols:
    # Convert to numeric first, then to Int64 (nullable integer dtype)
    df_final[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_final[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Convert float columns
float_cols = [
    'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17', 'Family_17',
    'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]
for col in float_cols:
    df_final[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_final[col], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# --- Step 6: Export the final dataframe to CSV ---
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
